identity: BTC/AUD = BTC/USD divided by AUD/USD, subject to exchange basis and timing mismatch

sign_convention.aud_usd: positive means USD per AUD rises (AUD strengthens)
sign_convention.denominator_identity: holding BTC/USD constant, AUD/USD up implies BTC/AUD down; AUD/USD down implies BTC/AUD up

required_tests: point-in-time source availability and exact version capture
publication, update, capture and retrieval timestamps stored separately
degree-1 baseline versus degree-2 and degree-3 incremental ablations
blocked and purged chronological walk-forward with train-only feature selection
80bps taker per side plus separate spread and slippage
A$100 inclusive entry debit and 10% available-cash cap
method.causality_warning: Edges are transmission hypotheses only. Correlation, lag association or event coincidence does not establish causation.
method.market_basis_warning: BTC/USD, AUD/USD and BTC/AUD sources may have different venues, timestamps, spreads and settlement conventions; align only completed observations and record basis residuals.
